title_zh: AI 系统评测报告全文：长序列预测与生成模型在历史实测与未来算力扩展下的精度-延迟帕累托报告

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 实验设置、数据集特性与强基线选型说明段（Experimental Setup & Baselines）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 Experiments 开篇说明：我们为什么选这几类数据集和这几类基线模型，证明我们的实验设计是全面、公平且直击痛点的。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Dataset Diversity -> Challenging Regime Highlights -> Categorized Strong Baselines -> Strict Fairness Protocol. 绑定逻辑规则：L009, L010.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: To evaluate robustness across diverse non-stationary regimes, we conduct experiments on seven public benchmarks spanning energy grid load (ETT, ECL), meteorological telemetry (Weather), and urban traffic flow (Traffic). Notably, Weather contains abrupt atmospheric pressure transitions that test non-stationary adaptability, whereas Traffic spans 862 synchronized sensors that challenge high-dimensional scalability. We benchmark our approach against 11 state-of-the-art methods across three paradigms: channel-independent patch Transformers (PatchTST), variate-mixing architectures (iTransformer, Crossformer), and frequency-domain forecasters (TimesNet, FEDformer). All baselines are reproduced under identical lookback windows ($L=96$) and prediction horizons ($H \in \{96, 192, 336, 720\}$) using standard MSE and MAE metrics.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 主实验结果整体对比与核心胜出原因剖析段（Main Results Analysis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想解读主实验大表（Table 1）：既报告全局胜率，又挑出最有代表性的对比案例，解释为什么竞争对手在那里跌倒而我们稳赢。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Global Win Rate -> Advantage over Family A -> Resilience at Long Horizon vs. Family B -> Mechanistic Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L015, L013, L010.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Table 1 reports the multivariate forecasting results, where DyTS-Net secures the lowest error in 25 out of 28 dataset-horizon configurations. Compared with channel-independent PatchTST, DyTS-Net reduces average MSE by 14.2% on the 862-channel Traffic benchmark, where modeling spatial-temporal congestion propagation across adjacent road sensors is critical. Furthermore, while variate-mixing iTransformer performs competitively at $H=96$, its MSE escalates by 68% at $H=720$ on volatile Weather series as unregularized cross-channel attention overfits transient wind gusts. By decoupling stationary phase coupling from neural-ODE scale projection, DyTS-Net suppresses long-horizon drift and maintains an 11.6% margin over the strongest baseline at $H=720$.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 计算开销、推理延迟与精度帕累托权衡段（Efficiency-Accuracy Pareto Analysis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想说明我们的模型不仅准，而且算得快、显存省，在“精度-延迟/显存”帕累托前沿（Pareto Frontier）上显著优于现有大模型。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Hardware Benchmark -> Complexity Reduction & Memory Gain -> Real-Time Latency Margin -> Pareto Conclusion. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L023.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Figure 6 plots the MSE-latency Pareto frontier measured on an onboard NVIDIA Orin AGX module. By replacing $O(L^2)$ point-wise self-attention with $O(L \log L)$ spectral filtering and compact patch tokens, DyTS-Net reduces peak GPU memory by 62% and training wall-clock time by 3.4x compared with iTransformer. At inference time, generating a 16-step visuomotor trajectory requires only 6.8 ms—well below the 20 ms cycle budget of a 50 Hz industrial robot controller—while outperforming a 200 ms DDPM baseline by 11.4% in task success rate.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Cross-referencing both figures reveals a strong inverse relationship between automated inspection investment and manufacturing defect rates up to a $40 million threshold. Specifically, across plants investing between $10 million and $40 million (Figure 1), surface defect incidence dropped steeply from 4.8% to 0.9% (Figure 2). Beyond $40 million, however, further capital expenditure yielded diminishing returns: doubling investment to $80 million reduced defects by only an additional 0.1 percentage points. Notably, Plant D defied this expenditure curve, achieving a 0.7% defect rate with just $22 million through closed-loop sensor calibration.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Historical Past (rose/accounted for) -> Pivot Year -> Future Projection Verbs (is projected/anticipated/expected to) -> Moderating Factor. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L017.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Between 2010 and 2025, global data-center electricity consumption more than doubled from 200 TWh to 460 TWh. From 2026 onward, total demand is projected to climb at a substantially steeper rate, with baseline forecasts pointing to 1,050 TWh by 2035. Within this expansion, AI model training and inference—which represented under 10% of server load in 2023—are anticipated to account for nearly half (46%) of total consumption by 2040. However, widespread deployment of sparsity-aware accelerators is expected to temper the annual growth rate after 2035.
